# telnyx_user_profile (Data Source)

The profile of the user the API key belongs to: name, business details, address and notification settings (beta). There is one per user; destroy removes it from Terraform state only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `address_1` (String) First line of the profile address.
- `address_2` (String) Second line of the profile address.
- `business_name` (String) Business name associated with the profile.
- `city` (String) City in the profile address.
- `country` (String) Country code in the profile address.
- `data_locality` (String) The user's data locality: USA (United States), DEU (Germany), AUS (Australia), UAE (United Arab Emirates), or CAN (Canada). One of `AUS`, `CAN`, `DEU`, `UAE`, `USA`.
- `data_locality_migration_status` (String) Status of the user's data locality migration, or null when no migration status is recorded.
- `data_locality_updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the user's data locality was last changed, or null if it has not been changed.
- `first_name` (String) The user's first name.
- `id` (String) Always user_profile: there is one per account.
- `last_name` (String) The user's last name.
- `phone_number` (String) Contact phone number associated with the profile.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of resource.
- `state` (String) State or region in the profile address.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp of the most recent profile update.
- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the user who owns this profile.
- `zip` (String) Postal code in the profile address.
